purpose: Sensor-only acquisition and recovery from a perturbed estimated state, single tag and IMU
primary_absolute_range: six frozen Delft TWR evaluation flights
ISAS Walk2 and Walk3 absolute-range ToA with Walk1-only cross-frame calibration
secondary_tdoa: Four Toronto UTIL trial4 flights, native signed TDoA and Vicon yaw, scored separately
selection: One recording-start and one interior recovery per flight; origins determined by sensor clocks, never localization errors
decision: Three consecutive half-second samples below threshold. Report the last (confirmation); first (entry) is also saved. Ground truth used only for offline assessment.
clock: Sensor-time first evidence/confirmation from release; add prefix for full input span. Compute-inclusive publication and queue delay are separate, hardware-dependent metrics.
time_alignment: At a live deadline hold the most recent released body-origin estimate and score against the truth at the deadline. At first publication also score against truth at the represented state epoch. No backdating spline or graph knots.
delft: Tick-derived intervals. Release 1.5 s after both IMU and changed positive range are present; recovery at midpoint of available on-board data rounded down to a logging sample. Common historical 0.2 s IMU/radio delay relative to OptiTrack. One held logger value per changed positive range. Six disjoint prior training logs supply constant range offsets and sigma.
prior_basis: Only XY and yaw centers are deliberately perturbed, never sensor values. No truth Z, tilt, speed or bias. Primary widths are position m and heading degrees. Delft lacks orientation truth; its yaw treatments are offsets of a sensor-defined horizontal frame.
stress_semantics: A native reset ignoring priors is evaluated once. An optimizer seed without a covariance input and a MAP estimator accepting a prior are distinct treatments. A fixed-deadline estimate is not a first-fix time.
independent_units: Separate flights; release points, directions, heading perturbations and widths within a flight are repeated conditions, not independent draws.
shared_sensor_axes: IMU stays in body axes; only survey/score frame may be rotated together. Gravity prefix common, no test truth passed to cold estimators.
decision_rule: No new manuscript claim of superiority if both real absolute-range sites do not support it on paired recording-level first-usable timing and XY/coverage. Different modalities are not pooled.
